note: Validation copy of thresholds.json: the same marks with the served-model scores removed, for runs of models that are not served on Orion, so their reports carry no served-model comparison. Placeholder values, not decided. Thresholds and min_scored floors are pending the advisor/Most meeting; verdicts produced with this file are provisional. max_excluded_fraction (the share of a case's prompts that may be excluded as failed or empty before the case is insufficient_data) is also a placeholder, 0.10 for every case, to be revisited once the cap calibration run has measured real cut-off rates. en_integrity is a higher_is_better pass rate; threshold 0.95, line_rule share_of_lines and share_threshold 0.25 were set 2026-11-05 from hand labels and a sensitivity grid; min_scored and max_excluded_fraction are unchanged. th_integrity is a higher_is_better pass rate whose threshold 0 is a placeholder that always passes, so a th_integrity pass is not evidence the Thai replies are well-formed until the threshold is set from the pilot replies; share_threshold 0.45 with line_rule share_of_lines was set 2026-11-06 from hand labels on the Mango Thai pilot and a sensitivity grid; min_thai_ratio, min_line_letters and foreign_letter_share are unchanged and untested beyond that grid. th_knowledge is a higher_is_better pooled accuracy whose threshold 0 is a placeholder that always passes, so a th_knowledge pass is vacuous; the pass mark is open, pending Most. Pass marks, served-model scores and min_scored 100 were set 2026-11-20 from the re-scored verdicts of the three served models; min_scored and th_integrity's mark are proposed, not confirmed.
